reader.requirement: At 1985, a WRITE to an indexed file whose FD has RECORD IS VARYING must, when the record's character positions (the DEPENDING ON data-name-1 value, else the record's size or its ODO-current size per §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10) fall below the clause's minimum or above its maximum, be unsuccessful: nothing written, record area (and every SAME RECORD AREA peer) unchanged, I-O status 44 (§1985:IX.1.3.4 status 44 item 1), no INVALID KEY branch. The witnesses are sequential-organization cases only; this rule is the Indexed module's.
reader.edition-search: grep Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel|DialectBehavior over IndexedConnector.cs (Write), KeyedConnector.cs (RecordRulesFailure), FileConnector.cs (Stored), FileRegistry.cs (WriteShared/WriteSharedInStatement) and KeyedIoEmitter.EmitWrite: the bounds test (Stored: len < VaryMin || len > VaryMax -> '44') consults no edition; the only edition-keyed member near it is FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect (record locking), reached after the size check and irrelevant to it.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses (pb1168, pb1190) are sequential-file cases; not exercised there: an indexed file, DEPENDING ON at 0/min-1/min/max/max+1/99, a SAME RECORD AREA peer left unchanged, the record-description SR2 refusal

probes.printed: VARYING 6..20 DEPENDING ON RL, indexed DYNAMIC: RL=5 -> W5 44 (RB, RL unchanged, no IK branch); RL=6 -> 00; RL=20 -> 00; RL=21 -> W21 44 RB unchanged; RL=0 -> 44; RL=99 -> 44; RL=3 -> 44 with SAME RECORD AREA peer RG still 1234.56; READ back only K06 (06) and K20 (20), EOF 10
probes.expected: outside 6..20: unsuccessful, not written, record area unaffected, status 44 (§1985:IX.1.3.4); at the bounds written

probes.printed: error COBOL2010: record 'RA' describes 4 bytes, which is fewer than the integer-2 = 6 ... (ANSI §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR2)
probes.expected: a record description below integer-2 is refused at compile time (SR2), so GR8's size test is reached through DEPENDING ON

probes.printed: VARYING 5..20 without DEPENDING ON, ODO 0..15: N=0 (5 chars) W1 00; WRITE FROM 20-char item, N=15 -> W2 00; reread K0100 and K0215ABCDEFGHIJKLMNO 00
probes.expected: ODO-current size at the minimum and maximum is in range and written (§1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10 c)

reader.notes: The emitter passes the DEPENDING ON value (VaryingLengthArg) and the connector's Stored() refuses a length outside VaryMin..VaryMax before any key work, returning '44' with nothing stored; the also-available store to SAME RECORD AREA peers is emitted under a success test (EndReleasedRecord), so the area stays unaffected. Probed at --std 85 at both bounds and beyond them.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-011/c4/r1.cob (--std 85, indexed ACCESS SEQUENTIAL, VARYING 6..20 DEPENDING ON RL, two 01s of 6 and 20): WRITE RS (6-char 01) with RL=21 -> 44, RL unchanged; then K03 (lower than the refused K05) with RL=20 -> 00, so the failed WRITE did not take place (no '21'); RL=5 -> 44; OPEN EXTEND WRITE RLONG RL=6 -> 00, RL=0 -> 44; reread K03 (20 chars, RL 20) and K09abc (RL 06), EOF leaves RL 06. Size taken from data-name-1, not from the 01 written (§1985:VII.3.8.4 GR10a). OK  §1985:IX.4.9.4 GR8 the text is in GR8; OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR9 the text is in GR9.
